def: properly, a story, but used in the sense of G1868 (ἔπαινος); praise (of God)

occurrences.text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
